title: Discover exact versioned test filenames before reading
failure_signature: A predecessor x2 test filename was inferred incorrectly and the aggregate read exited nonzero.
candidate_workaround: List tracked tests with a version-specific ripgrep filter before reading the exact returned path.
recurrence_guard: Discover exact paths from the tracked inventory and reject partial aggregate output when any requested path is absent.
rollback: Discard the failed aggregate; the operation was read-only.
scope_boundary: This method validates versioned test-path discovery only and does not establish test correctness.
